title: Spiral Matrix
summary: Read the matrix in clockwise spiral order from the upper-left cell.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–10 rows and columns. Each entry is in [−100,100].

statement: Read the matrix in clockwise spiral order from the upper-left cell. Traverse each outer ring, then continue inward until every cell appears once.

examples.explanation: Read the top row, then return along the bottom.
The only column is read once.
Follow the top and right edges before coming back up the left.

constraints: 1–10 rows and columns. Each entry is in [−100,100].
hints: Conceptual: Track which rectangle has yet to be visited.
Directional: Read the top, right, bottom, and left sides in order.
Implementation: Shrink a boundary after each side. Recheck that the remaining rectangle still has both rows and columns.
complexityAnalysis: O(mn) time and O(1) extra space excluding the result.
